volumes.title: First Principles
volumes.subtitle: Twenty teardowns of what things really cost — and what they could
volumes.author: Patrick Novak
volumes.description: What would this cost if physics were the only constraint? Each story applies the first-principles lens — the magic wand number and the Idiot Index — to one industry or one historical breakthrough, from freight rail to fertilizer, tracing the gap between what something costs and what the raw materials and energy say it should. Compiled from the First Principles Daily podcast.

volumes.title: Unintended Consequences
volumes.subtitle: Twenty true stories of good intentions gone spectacularly wrong
volumes.author: Patrick Novak
volumes.description: True, carefully reconstructed stories of policies, inventions, and plans that achieved the exact opposite of what their designers intended — each one traced from the good intention, through the mechanism that turned it inside out, to the lesson that travels. Compiled from the Unintended Consequences podcast.
